title: Alien
synopsis: A space tug, a distress beacon, an egg, and a chest cavity that does not appreciate visitors.

nodes.text: A signal at the edge of charted space.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Discipline.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Lazy.

nodes.text: A rocky moon under a yellow sky and a horseshoe ship in the dust.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Cautious.

nodes.text: Leathery shapes in fog with a thing twitching beneath each lid.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Step back.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Lean in” back. Reckless shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A spider with a tail wraps a man's helmet.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Mercy.

nodes.text: Ripley at the door. Ash at the latch.

choices.consequence: “Side with Ripley” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Discipline.
“Override the lock” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Mercy.

nodes.text: A facehugger drops off and walks itself into a corner.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Hard.

nodes.text: Kane laughs at the table about a long sleep ahead.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Friend—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Stay back” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Wary.

nodes.text: A small wet thing on the table running for a vent.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Pursue.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.
“Brace” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.

nodes.text: Air ducts and a tracker that pings irregularly.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Smart.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Reckless—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Jonesy hisses at a door that should not be unlocked.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Follow Jonesy.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Cold—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: A wet sound up in the chains.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Run” back. Smart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Reckless.

nodes.text: Captain in coveralls with a flame thrower.

choices.consequence: “Talk to him on comms” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Friend.
There is no taking “Stay quiet” back. Cautious shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Mother's screen reveals the crew is expendable.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Brave—follows you into whatever comes next.
“Hide your knowledge” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Cunning.

nodes.text: A magazine rolled in his hand, white fluid on his collar.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Decapitate him” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You commit to “Talk first.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: He laughs at your odds.

nodes.text: A countdown, a long corridor, a thing in the way.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Final.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Cautious.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Grab him” back. Heart shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A scream, an impact, a corridor that goes quiet too fast.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Smart.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Loyal.

nodes.text: A small bay, a small ship, an escape that fits two if one is a cat.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Smart.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: The alien folded into a wall plate behind the seats.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Vent the cabin.” The story records the instinct as “Brave” and carries it forward.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Honest.

nodes.text: A log entry to a Company recorder no one will check for fifty-seven years.

choices.consequence: “Tell the truth” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Honest.
You commit to “Lie a little.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: Ripley, Nostromo, signing off. The cat curls against your boot and the cryo bay hums and you sleep without dreams for the first time in months.
You and Jonesy drift through space toward a frontier station, half a century out, a small lifeboat and a clean ledger of survival.
You wake up to find Jonesy purring against the glass of his cryo tube and you both look at each other for a long calm second before you go back under.
